$comment: No $id on purpose: Test-Json resolves relative references only without an absolute $id, and every Rulebook schema follows the same rule.
title: Rulebook diagnostic catalog
description: catalog/diagnostics.json of an organization rulebook repository: every known diagnostic id with its analyzer default (D24). Minimal on purpose: the three fields the generator needs are required, the other known fields are typed, the scan fields (WP08, D46) are typed too, and a later scan may add more per entry. See docs/reference/naming.md.

diagnosticId.description: A diagnostic id: two or three capital letters, four digits, an optional lowercase i (PTE0011, AL0432, LC0089i).

defaultValue.description: A defaultSeverity or an enabledByDefault value.

advertised.description: false when the descriptor exists in the package but no analyzer returns it (D46); the scan writes only false.

deprecated.description: true when the newest stable descriptor is deprecated (D46); the scan writes only true.

defaultChanges.description: One element per analyzer default that changed in a stable version (D24).
